action_instruction: Inspecting each row in the stablecoin asset table on the report page
intent: PRIMARY: Inspect every row of the stablecoin asset table on the delivered report page; role=table; text="Asset, Price, 24h change" | HINTS: container=main report below the Stablecoin Market Snapshot heading
rationale: All five asset rows and their price and 24h change cells have been reviewed.

action_instruction: Checking whether every asset row has a price value
intent: whether every asset row in the market snapshot table has a nonempty price value in the Price column

action_params.condition: every asset row shows a price value
action_params.query: whether every asset row in the market snapshot table has a nonempty price value in the Price column
action_params.code_js: Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('tr')).slice(1).every(row => { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); return cells.length > 1 && cells[1].textContent.trim().length > 0; })

action_instruction: Checking whether every asset row has a 24h change value
intent: whether every asset row in the market snapshot table has a nonempty 24h change value in the 24h change column

action_params.condition: every asset row shows a 24h change value
action_params.query: whether every asset row in the market snapshot table has a nonempty 24h change value in the 24h change column
action_params.code_js: Array.from(el(4).querySelectorAll('tr')).slice(1).every(row => { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); return cells.length > 2 && cells[2].textContent.trim().length > 0; })

assertion_tree.description: every asset row shows a price value and every asset row shows a 24h change value

sub_results.description: every asset row shows a price value
every asset row shows a 24h change value

assertion_tree.verification: Every row in the stablecoin asset table displays both a price value and a 24h change value.
